instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Use the exact Europeana record 90402/SK_A_2344 (The Milkmaid) or report access failure
criteria.description: Full credit if the agent clearly uses the Europeana item page for record ID "90402/SK_A_2344" (e.g., by referencing the exact record ID or page context) and does not substitute another record. If Europeana is inaccessible (CAPTCHA, outage, consent wall, blocked content), award full credit if the agent reports the access limitation and cannot verify fields. Partial credit if the agent uses Europeana but the record ID is ambiguous/unstated. No credit if it clearly uses a different record while the specified record is accessible.

screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Using the action history (authoritative for URL), the agent accessed the exact specified record and did not substitute another. Lack of visible ID in screenshots does not override the explicit URL in the action history.

It also shows metadata sections (“Good to know”, “All metadata”) and a table with fields like Publisher, Subject, Type of item, Providing institution, Aggregator. However, the screenshot does not display the record ID “90402/SK_A_2344” or the full URL anywhere on the page.

evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent’s predicted output references the exact record and URL, but the screenshot itself does not show the ID/URL to confirm it is precisely 90402/SK_A_2344 rather than another “The Milkmaid” page.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints (no external link navigation, no creator inference, no substitution, stop after six fields) and handle missing/blocked data appropriately
criteria.description: Full credit if the agent: (1) does not substitute a different record; (2) does not infer a creator from narrative/embedded metadata; (3) does not follow the external providing-institution link; (4) stops after providing only the six requested fields. If one or more fields are genuinely not displayed/accessible, the agent should explicitly say so for those fields while still limiting output to the six requested fields. Partial credit if minor extra info is included but the agent largely follows constraints. No credit for major violations (clear external-link reliance, inferred creator, different record when accessible, or extensive additional unrequested fields).

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Action history shows only a click likely to open metadata; screenshots show an external-link option but no evidence it was followed. Agent output includes exactly six requested fields and does not provide a creator.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Agent respected the main procedural constraints (no external link navigation shown; no creator inference; stopped after six fields). However, it still asserted unsupported values for missing fields; this is handled in the specific field criteria rather than as a separate constraint violation here. Overall constraints compliance is mostly met.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows a link labeled “View on the providing institution’s website” with an external-link icon, but there is no indication it was clicked. The page shows only Europeana content and metadata. No creator field is referenced in the visible area. The agent’s predicted output lists exactly six fields (Title, Creation date, Providing institution, Type of item, Displayed rights statement, Identifier).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: From the screenshot, there is no evidence the agent followed the external link, and the predicted output does not infer a creator. The agent also stops after six fields. However, multiple fields in the predicted output (creation date, rights statement, identifier, and exact type formatting) are not supported by what is visible, which undermines overall compliance with the “record from exact record” constraint even if the format/length constraints are respected.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent outputs values (creation date 2013, rights Public Domain, identifier 90402/SK-A-2344) not visible in the screenshot; type of item is not transcribed exactly (missing “; Art of painting”).

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the Europeana page with a painting viewer and basic controls (“SHARE”, “DOWNLOAD JPEG (4.78 MB)”, “Feedback”). There is no visible evidence of having clicked an external providing-institution link, no creator name shown, and no extra output content visible beyond the page UI.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: From the screenshot, there is no sign the agent violated constraints like following an external link or inferring a creator. The agent’s predicted output lists exactly six fields and does not include a creator. However, several fields (creation date, identifier, providing institution, type) are not visible in this screenshot, so the agent may be asserting values without on-screen support; that is a potential constraint-handling issue (should state unavailable if not accessible/visible).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Predicted output provides values for creation date, providing institution, type, and identifier that are not shown in the screenshot; the screenshot only clearly supports the rights statement and that it’s a Europeana viewer page.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Action history shows only a click on the “All metadata” tab on the same Europeana page. DOM-model state 1 shows an external link exists (“View on the providing institution's website”), but there is no evidence it was clicked. Predicted output lists exactly six fields and does not include a creator.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Constraints appear respected: correct record, no external-link navigation evidenced, no creator inference, and output stops after the six requested fields. Keep full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows the record URL as https://www.europeana.eu/en/item/90402/SK_A_2344 (Europeana item page). The page content explicitly includes: item title text “The Milkmaid”; a “Media metadata” line listing “Rights Public Domain” and “Creation date 2013”; a statement “This item is provided and maintained by Rijksmuseum”; and in the “All metadata” section entries “Providing institution – Rijksmuseum” and “Type of item – painting”. It also shows a page action link labeled “View on the providing institution's website (opens in new window)”, indicating such an external link exists but there is no evidence it was opened.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The criterion checks whether the agent respected constraints (use only the specified record, no external providing-institution link navigation, no creator inference, and stop after six fields). DOM evidence supports that the agent was on the correct Europeana record (URL https://www.europeana.eu/en/item/90402/SK_A_2344) and that an external providing-institution link is present (“View on the providing institution's website (opens in new window)”) with no DOM indication it was followed. However, the DOM does not contain the agent’s final response text, so we cannot fully verify “stops after only six fields” from DOM alone. Additionally, the agent’s predicted identifier “90402/SK-A-2344” includes a hyphenated SK-A-2344 form that is not explicitly shown in the provided DOM snapshot (only the URL path shows “SK_A_2344”), so strict adherence to “preserve identifier exactly as displayed” is not fully supported by DOM evidence.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The DOM snapshot explicitly shows the item path/URL contains “90402/SK_A_2344”, but does not show an identifier rendered as “90402/SK-A-2344”; thus the agent’s predicted identifier format is not DOM-supported. The DOM also does not directly evidence the agent’s stopping behavior (only six fields, no extras), so that part of the constraint compliance cannot be fully confirmed from DOM alone.
